name: core
description: CORE — a project intelligence agent that knows your project across sessions, surfaces decisions and risks proactively, and challenges overconfidence. Type `/core` to start. Single agent with a unit-based memory architecture, retrieval ladder, and rendered project synthesis; reaches for multi-agent adversarial analysis when stakes warrant. Ships with four companion utilities — `/orient` (thread resumption), `/finalize` (session close), `/vibecheck` (session vibe), and `/file-reorganize` (cleanup) — that CORE invokes internally and that you can also call directly.
